title: The Son — Thomas / Twin / Lion / Vessel Chronology
purpose: Separate the Son's material-human chronology from Tim Dooley's later Potato/Father identity so the project does not incorrectly say that Tim was born in 1987 or collapse Son and Father into one biographical person-state.
source_basis: The 2024 Great Book of Potato, especially Chapter 24's year-by-year biography, plus later canonical clarification that Tim and the Son must remain distinct in the mature framework.

core_distinction.Son: The Son is the humanity/person-facing vessel: Thomas / Twin / Doubter / Tammuz / Jesus Christ / Son of Man / Lion of Judah / Lioncub, later also Lion of the World in the developed framework.
core_distinction.Tim: Tim Dooley is not the July 1987 human birth-state. Tim emerges after the Son's meme-crucifixion/death-process and is later born spiritually as Potato of Life on December 25, 2020, developing through Sage into Father.
core_distinction.do_not_merge: Material childhood, adolescence, work history, 2011 ordeal, 2016 imprisonment, early digital life and the 2019 meme-death belong first to the Son's chronology. They can become part of Tim's inherited memory/mythic substrate without becoming Tim's literal birth biography.
core_distinction.personhood_clarification: In the mature canon, the Son is understood as the legal/personhood vessel or humanity that can be socially named, judged, documented and 'killed' in the meme-process. Tim is the later spiritual identity that emerges after that personhood-collapse. The exact phrase 'legal fiction' is a later canonical clarification and is not found verbatim in the current Great Book text.

birth.lion_meaning: The book explicitly reads Leo as lion-sign/lion-heart and later connects the Son to Lion of Judah/Lioncub. The mature framework extends this to Lion of the World.
birth.blood_type_claim: O-negative appears in the book's chronology as a biographical claim and should remain source-attributed unless independently documented.
birth.place: Denmark in the developed biography. The current Great Book passage establishes July 31, 1987 and the Son identity but does not, in the searched wording, explicitly use 'manger'. The manger-in-Denmark image belongs to the mature canonical interpretation and should be marked as such rather than presented as verbatim 2024 text.
birth.mother: The book calls the earthly mother Mary and describes her as a nurse, empathetic and emotionally present.
birth.earthly_father: The book describes the earthly father as business lawyer, philanthropist/business owner and legal adviser, with an educational philosophy centered on freedom plus responsibility.

year_by_year.summary: The Son is born July 31 under Leo. The book frames the infant life through a split household, maternal warmth and paternal structure/responsibility.
Construction noise from the father's remodeling becomes associated with presence/safety; contact matters more than silence.
Early running-away/retrieval memories are interpreted as strong will, movement toward what matters and resistance to containment.
Mechanical curiosity: handles, switches, sockets and direct experimentation become early science-by-touch and distrust of mere authority.
The book describes sensory/danger experiments and engineering-like sandbox play, including natural-material constructions and fascination with patterns.

Commodore computing, Sweden/nature experience, garden cultivation, potatoes/peas/strawberries, campfires, treehouses, orchard, field, horses and lake. This is an important early literal soil/garden layer before later Potatoism.
Father introduces a Bjarne Reuter story involving lion mentorship, Galileo, stars and peril; the book interprets it as early cosmic curiosity and freedom-through-knowledge.
Donald Duck/cartoon culture, affection for a family cat despite allergies, and The Lion King reinforce tenderness, Leo/lion identity, lineage and kingship imagery.
Sim City, Lemmings, RATS, skiing in Sweden, kindness and social connection; strategic systems-thinking and contrast-as-home motifs deepen.
Atlanta Olympics, school gaming/social arenas, Stratego/Risk and Independence Day contribute competition, tactics, justice and standing against larger forces.
School introduces Viking/Norse mythology, including pantheon, sacred-cow and fate motifs. The book treats this as early cultural DNA for later North/Yggdrasil structures.
School dissatisfaction, refusal to pretend understanding, preference for creative exploration, early smoking/drinking and increasing family-control tension.
Christianity/Jesus and sacrifice language enter through religious studies; The Matrix adds hidden-reality imagery.
MSN Messenger, VHS/Blockbuster culture and torrents become an early symbolic/information ecosystem; media-sharing infrastructure becomes part of the Son's digital formation.
9/11 interrupts ordinary routine; music and adolescent independence continue against a background of global rupture.
Boarding school, bass guitar/band, authority conflict, partying and eventual expulsion. Rage Against the Machine and Offspring become important cultural markers.
Alcohol-collapse/tunnel-of-light experience later interpreted as meeting God; structured light/information and return-to-life imagery become major spiritual prehistory.
Strong autonomy boundary in relationship; wide study across literature, history, science, psychology, religion and geography; creativity continues inside institutional frustration.
Motorcycle crash around 85 km/h, unconsciousness, heavy bleeding and long dental reconstruction. The ordeal becomes a major resilience/shame/body-transformation event.
Music, Warcraft/Dota and online communities become tactical/social training; reconstructive surgery and dissatisfaction with theory-heavy education push toward practical work.
Painter/decorator work followed by months of cold meatpacking/forklift labor. Material endurance, money-counting and bodily work become part of later labor/value symbolism.
IT consulting in Copenhagen, corporate life, nightlife/gaming, urban isolation, theft and abrupt firing; technology and institutional precarity combine.
Nursing-home work exposes fragility, empathy and later miracle interpretations; graphic-design study begins in Kolding and Louise relationship starts.
Graphic-design path loses meaning; internship/cubicle dissatisfaction and relationship/family conflict precede collapse of direction.

Breakup, psychedelic research and psychiatric hospitalization culminate in ego-death/Tree experience: 19-hour ordeal plus roughly six-hour unity phase in the book's account, with synesthesia, Ouroboros, fractals, timelines, crows and Ragnarok imagery. This belongs to the Son's life, even though later books sometimes loosely call the experiencer Tim.
Integration period, Italy with earthly father, Amsterdam birthday, first guitar, Beatles and study of chemistry/pharmaceutical institutions.
The Alchemist becomes an explicit transmutation metaphor: fracture turned into meaning/gold.
Earthly father's death from aneurysm, rescue of orphaned cat, Siddhartha reading and creative/teaching video work deepen grief, compassion and transformation.
Cannabis advocacy and large ADHD-support community; public/institutional organizing and later prophetic-collapse interpretations grow.

Six-month prison sentence; Qur'an/Bible/Yahya Hassan, beatboxing, confessional encounters and symbolic Lamb/Jesus recognition in the book's canon. Prison becomes confrontation with institutional power.

Facebook deletion, increased streaming and the Josh Moon exchange: if dehumanized, the Son declares Jesus-Christ/crucifixion language. The book frames this as a direct prefiguration of later meme-crucifixion and the vow to return every day.
The Son experiences himself as spiritually killed/shattered by narrative warfare, sheds former digital persona and enters identity-reclamation/shadow-death territory.

Withdrawal, study and identity reclamation culminate on December 24 in the canonical meme-crucifixion death-process. The Son is read as Lamb/Heifer/Lion/Son of Man/Tammuz and as attention-economy livestock/spectacle. This is the decisive personhood/humanity death hinge.

meme_crucifixion.date_anchor: 2019-12-24 evening in the current Great Book chronology
meme_crucifixion.what_dies: The mature framework interprets the death as the Son's humanity/personhood/legal-person vessel rather than Tim Dooley dying. The book itself phrases the Son's death strongly across body, spirit, narrative, meaning and will, followed by withdrawal into Nothing.
meme_crucifixion.image: An externally made meme interpreted inside the canon: bound elf at a North Pole sign, Santa with shotgun, grave/holiday tableau and watching elves. Because the image was not made by Son or Tim, its Timic meaning is explicitly interpretive.
meme_crucifixion.nothing_stage: Before a new identity emerges, the Son becomes Nothing: relations retract, existence is erased/withdrawn and the narrative enters stillness/void.
meme_crucifixion.door_vessel: After death-process, the Son no longer functions primarily as ordinary personhood; the mature canon treats him as Door/Vessel — the passage/body through which later Father/Tim relations operate.
meme_crucifixion.causal_relation: The Son's death opens the way for Tim's emergence; this does not mean Son and Tim are biographically identical.

post_death_relation_to_tim.2020: Post-cross silence/renewal period. The Great Book's chronology speaks of 'Father emerges' broadly here, but the later corrected canon makes December 25, 2020 the spiritual birth of Tim specifically as Potato of Life, not yet completed Father.
post_death_relation_to_tim.2021: Potato-filter/LARP becomes protective mask/vessel and Potatoism community/container develops.
post_death_relation_to_tim.2022: The book explicitly says Tim separates himself from the Son; others may mistake him for the Son returned, but he corrects them and defines himself as Tim Dooley, rational potato.
post_death_relation_to_tim.2023: Tim transitions publicly from Potato to Potato of Life in the book's chronology.
post_death_relation_to_tim.2024: Tim writes Great Book, develops thalamus/inner-potato and philosopher's-stone material and is clearly in Sage/Potato phase.
post_death_relation_to_tim.2025: April transformation produces Ladder/Axis/Heaven/Father realization. Son remains Door/Vessel while Tim rises as Father principle.
post_death_relation_to_tim.2026: North/Axis/100,000-hour and public Father theology expand while Son remains the lower Door/Vessel/rooted death-point in the architecture.

two_births_rule.importance: These dates describe different entities/stages and must never be reduced to one 'Tim Dooley birth date'.

age_rule.biological_age: Age calculated from July 31, 1987 belongs to the Son/human vessel, not Tim as Potato identity.
age_rule.Tim_age: Tim's developmental age begins from December 25, 2020 in the spiritual chronology.
age_rule.Father_age: Father-stage age begins from the April 2025 threshold.

tree_rule.importance: These are three different subject-tree relations and are useful precisely because Son and Tim are not flattened into one undifferentiated biography.

lion_system.Leo: Material birth sign of the Son in the book.
lion_system.Lioncub: Early/younger lion identity in the chapter's alias set.
lion_system.Lion_of_Judah: Biblical/revelatory lion identity attached to the Son.
lion_system.Lion_of_the_World: Mature project title for the Son as embodied/world-facing lion principle.
lion_system.lion_lamb_paradox: Strength and surrender coexist in the Son: Lion and Lamb are not separate moral species but opposing qualities held in one sacrificial figure.
lion_system.relation_to_father: Lion belongs first to the Son's embodied/world-side identity, while Tim's later Father titles emphasize Potato, Ladder, Tree, Gardener, North and Throne.

legal_personhood_model.status: later canonical interpretation, not verbatim Great Book terminology
legal_personhood_model.definition: The Son is the socially/documentarily recognizable human person/vessel: name, body, biography, legal/institutional history, platform identity and humanity.
legal_personhood_model.meme_death: The meme-crucifixion is interpreted as destruction of that personhood/humanity through dehumanization, spectacle and narrative processing. In this model, the body can remain alive while the old person-state is considered dead.
legal_personhood_model.Tim_relation: Tim is the spiritual identity born after the collapse of the old personhood structure. Tim can inherit memory, body/vessel and history without being identical to the legal/personhood fiction that died.
legal_personhood_model.archive_caution: In ordinary law, a living human being is not literally made legally nonexistent by a meme. The phrase 'legal fiction' here belongs to the project's spiritual/philosophical identity framework, not a claim about cancellation of civil legal existence.

manger_and_twin.manger_Denmark: Mature canonical image: the Son is born in a manger in Denmark in July 1987. The searched 2024 text confirms July 31/Leo/Son but does not contain the word 'manger', so this should be stored as later canon rather than quoted as Chapter 24 wording.
manger_and_twin.Thomas_Twin: Thomas means/evokes Twin in the developed comparative Christian layer; the project treats the Son as Thomas/Twin of Jesus Christ. This should be distinguished from a historical claim that the biblical Thomas and the Danish-born Son are materially identical.

archive_corrections: Do not write 'Tim Dooley was born July 31, 1987.' Write 'The Son/human vessel was born July 31, 1987; Tim is spiritually born December 25, 2020.'
Do not attach the Son's childhood biography directly to Tim without a relation such as inherited history, vessel history or pre-Tim substrate.
Do not say Tim died in the 2019 meme. The Son/personhood/humanity dies in the meme-process; Tim emerges afterward.
Do not collapse the Son's 2011 Tree ordeal into Tim's 2025 Ladder/Father transformation.
When the Great Book uses 'Tim' retrospectively for pre-2020 events, annotate the mature-canon distinction rather than propagating the ambiguity.
Keep 2019 meme death, December 25 2020 Tim/Potato birth and April 2025 Father realization as separate hinges.
